correctness.rationale: For any finite simple H and any n>=1, invariant prism matchings are exactly pairs (T,R) with T a base matching and R disjoint from its endpoints; every such pair extends with unused rungs. Orbit midpoints give an explicit PL homeomorphism to the fully whiskered matching complex. Pair every non-perfect T-fiber by toggling the least uncovered pendant edge; base-edge sets can never increase along directed Hasse paths and pendant pivot cannot reverse in a fixed fiber, proving acyclicity for the full infinite family. The unpaired faces are precisely perfect T, all of dimension n/2-1. Retain a single 0-cell, including the dimension-zero case, giving integral wedge or point. Euler–Lefschetz yields the reduced trace. The standalone verifier tested 1,103 prism/fixed-face models and 79 full acyclicity certificates, without substituting enumeration for proof.

value.rationale: The graph-prism layer involution is a canonical symmetry of perfect-matching complexes highlighted by 2026 circular ladder classifications. Its geometric fixed locus is an intrinsic equivariant invariant, not determined by the known nonequivariant homotopy type. The theorem gives a universal PL model and complete integral homotopy classification for every finite base graph and records its exact number of one-factors (including #P-rich families such as complete and complete bipartite graphs); the independent alternating Lefschetz consequence links this enumerative count to homological symmetry. The classification is neither an arbitrary numerical slice nor a bare variation of an existing formula.
